gaps.sentence: ___ (APPOINT) with the results, the board replaced the management.
gaps.hint: participle adjective: how the board felt
gaps.explanation: 'Disappointed with the results' — the board experienced disappointment; '-ing' would describe the results.

gaps.sentence: The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.
It is ___ (DENY) that the policy has failed.
gaps.explanation: 'It is undeniable that …' — adjective meaning cannot be denied.

gaps.sentence: The road was closed because of ___ (VISIBLE) conditions.
gaps.hint: noun phrase: how far you can see
gaps.explanation: 'Visibility' = the distance you can see; paired with 'poor'.

gaps.sentence: The city is ___ (FAME) for its architecture.
gaps.explanation: 'Famous for' — 'infamous' means notorious (famous for bad things).
